title: My Dad Blamed My Games for Our Water Bill #shorts

cast.dad: a stick-figure father with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs, short brown hair and a blue flannel shirt
cast.girl: a stick-figure girl with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs, two black pigtails and a purple hoodie

lines.text: Dad blamed my gaming for our water bill, so where was all that water going?
lines.label: hook
lines.headline: where did the water go
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, standing in a kitchen holding up exactly one paper water bill, shocked face, pointing at exactly one small flat black game console box on a shelf, no TV in the picture, evening

lines.text: Dad said, "You game past midnight with soda, so I hear you flushing all night."
lines.label: the charge
lines.headline: dad hears flushing
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, standing in a dark upstairs hallway at night with one hand cupped to his ear, frowning, mouth open talking

lines.text: The bill had doubled, so he locked my console in the garage for a month.
lines.label: stakes
lines.headline: console locked away
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, putting exactly one small flat black game console box into exactly one metal cabinet in a garage, stern face, no TV in the picture

lines.text: But that night, with no games and no soda, Dad still heard the flushing.
lines.label: worse
lines.headline: still flushing
lines.image: close-up of {dad}, the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, standing in a dark hallway at night beside one closed bathroom door, hand cupped to his ear, eyes wide

lines.text: Dad said flushing meant I was up sneaking games, so he took my phone too.
lines.label: more blame
lines.headline: phone gone too
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, standing in a hallway holding exactly one phone up high out of reach, frowning, evening light

lines.text: I cried into my pillow, blamed and grounded for water I never even used.
lines.label: alone
lines.headline: blamed and grounded
lines.image: close-up of {girl}, the only person in the picture, two black pigtails and purple hoodie, lying alone in bed hugging her pillow, a single tear running down her cheek, sad eyes, dim bedroom at night

lines.text: Lying awake, I heard the flushing hiss every twenty minutes, like a game's respawn timer.
lines.label: gamer clue
lines.headline: respawn timer
lines.image: close-up of {girl}, the only person in the picture, two black pigtails and purple hoodie, lying awake in bed in the dark, eyes wide open, one finger raised as if counting, a simple drawing of one hourglass in a thought bubble above her head, no clock, no numbers or text

lines.text: At the next hiss, I checked the bathroom: empty, but the toilet was refilling itself.
lines.label: discovery
lines.headline: toilet refills itself
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, two black pigtails and purple hoodie, standing alone in a bathroom doorway at night looking at exactly one white toilet, a small trickle of water running inside its bowl as the tank refills, small night light glowing, eyes wide, nobody else in the picture

lines.text: I dripped food coloring into the tank and told Dad, "Nobody flush for ten minutes."
lines.label: hero move
lines.headline: food coloring test
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, two black pigtails and purple hoodie, kneeling beside exactly one white toilet with the tank lid off, squeezing exactly one small bottle of blue food coloring into the tank water, focused face, morning

lines.text: Ten minutes later Dad's jaw dropped: the bowl was blue, and nobody had flushed.
lines.label: proof
lines.headline: the bowl turns blue
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, bending over exactly one white toilet and staring at bright blue water in the bowl, jaw dropped, eyes wide, morning

lines.text: A worn rubber flap was leaking, and each refill was the flushing Dad heard.
lines.label: the twist
lines.headline: the worn flap
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, two black pigtails and purple hoodie, pointing into exactly one open white toilet tank at one worn cracked black rubber flap at the bottom with a thin trickle of water escaping, proud face

lines.text: New flap, normal bill, console back, but Dad still says I game way too late.
lines.label: the ending
lines.headline: console back
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, short brown hair and blue flannel shirt, standing in a living room doorway at night with arms crossed, grumpy smile, exactly one small flat black game console box back on a shelf behind him, the only console in the picture, no TV in the picture
